title: introduce-metric-dependency-graph-and-alert-orchestrator
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Motivation: We frequently see noisy correlated signals where a downstream alert creates a cascade of symptom alerts and noisy paging. This PR introduces a lightweight metric dependency graph and an alert orchestrator that uses that graph to: 1) compute transitive impact scores for alerts, 2) suppress or de-duplicate follow-on alerts for 60s by default, and 3) publish derived metrics (root-cause-likelihood, alert-impact-score) for dashboards and SLO decomposition. Design summary: - graph_builder: constructs a directed weighted graph from time-series cross-correlation and historical co-incident alert windows. We persist the graph as a compact adjacency list and per-edge confidence scores. - orchestrator: a service that subscribes to alert events and consults the graph to decide suppression, priority escalation, and annotated alert payloads. - derived metrics: we emit root_cause_prob and impact_score per-alert as time series with tags (route, model, tenant). - dashboard: new "Metric Dependency Explorer" dashboard that visualizes the graph, highlights high-impact nodes, and provides a ranked list of candidate root causes for a selected incident. - token-level tie-in: when an alert is related to inference performance we annotate impact_score with token_cost_delta and tail_latency_fraction to assist SREs in triage. Rollout plan: - deploy graph_builder and orchestrator to staging behind feature flag (obs.dep_graph=true). - collect 72h of graph telemetry, validate edges against known incidents. - enable passive mode (annotate-only) for 24h in prod, then enable suppression for a small subset of tenants. - full rollout after two production incidents validated and no regressions in alerting noise. Migration notes: - existing alert pipelines are unchanged when feature flag is off. - a small database migration adds dep_graph_v1 table; migration script included and is backwards compatible. Checklists: - [x] Graph construction pipeline implemented and unit tested. - [x] Orchestrator service with circuit breaker and rate limit implemented. - [x] Dashboard panels and quickstart doc added. - [x] Integration tests in qa/staging for end-to-end alert flow. - [x] Runbook draft linked. Testing: - unit tests cover graph heuristics and suppression logic. - synthetic incident generator used to validate no increased false negatives on a sample of historical incidents. - load test: orchestrator sustained 10k alerts/min with 12ms median decision latency in staging. Risks & mitigations: - risk: incorrect graph edges could suppress a true root alert. mitigation: default to annotate-only mode for new edges below confidence threshold 0.6; suppression requires confidence >= 0.85. - risk: increased cardinality on derived metrics. mitigation: we bucket tenant tags for derived metrics and sample low-volume tenants. Notes for reviewers: focus on graph weighting heuristics (graph_builder/weights.py) and suppression safety checks (orchestrator/safety.go). Link to runbook: https://linear.app/redwood/obs/dep-graph-runbook. Related: ENG-1429 (alert noise reduction), ENG-1484 (token-cost triage integration).

review_comments: Luca Martinez: Can you explain how the graph handles transient correlations (e.g. release day spikes)? Suggest adding time-decay to edge weights.
Priya Natarajan (author): Added exponential time-decay factor and a configurable decay window (defaults to 7d) in weights.py per your suggestion.
Sara Cho: Suppression safety looks good but please add metrics to track suppressed_alerts_count and recovery_false_negatives. Also add a flagged_rollback tag when suppression is reversed.
Priya Natarajan (author): Added suppressed_alerts_count and recovery_false_negative gauges. Orchestrator sets flagged_rollback tag when a suppression is undone. Tests updated.
Ethan Blake: The dashboard is helpful; can we add a CSV export for selected subgraphs? Could be handy for oncall handover.
Priya Natarajan (author): Added export endpoint to dashboard JSON (link to export job) and small UI note in metric-dependency.md.
Luca Martinez: CI flaked on e2e once; re-ran and green. Approving pending a small nit in docs formatting.
Sara Cho: Approving — verified no noisy regressions on staging after 48h annotate-only run.
release_notes: Add metric dependency graph and alert orchestrator to reduce alert noise and surface probable root causes. Includes dashboard and derived metrics for triage. Rolling rollout behind feature flag; no breaking changes by default.
notes_on_migration: Adds dep_graph_v1 table. Migration is online and safe; default retention 30d. Ops: run migrations in maintenance window for large clusters; script idempotent.
